listing_title: Appartamento Metrature Importanti - Lido di Jesolo — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / APPARTAMENTO METRATURE IMPORTANTI - LIDO DI JESOLO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Appartamento Metrature Importanti - Lido di Jesolo PIAZZA MAZZINI · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €315,000 Photos (19) Floor plans (1) 1 / 19 FLOOR AREA 120 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS B Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! Just a few steps from Piazza Mazzini, in the heart of one of the most sought-after areas of Jesolo, and only 500 meters from the beach, we offer for sale a bright apartment located on the third floor of a residential building with only nine units. This property is ideal both as a vacation home and as a primary residence thanks to its independent heating system, making it perfectly livable all year round. The living space welcomes you with a spacious living room of nearly 40 sqm, enhanced by an open kitchen—a convivial area with direct access to the terrace that surrounds the entire apartment. The night zone consists of a large master bedroom, a double bedroom, two bathrooms (both windowed), one with a bathtub and one with a shower, plus a practical storage room used as laundry. The property has recently undergone renovations—both internal and external—offering modern environments that are well-kept and ready to move in. The condominium also features communal gardens and presents the possibility of installing an elevator—a valuable addition for future considerations. The exterior will be repainted by late 2026, and an elevator will be installed upon consent from the homeowners' assembly. Completing this property (available for separate purchase) are two covered parking spaces priced at €10,000 each and a cellar at €5,000. An ideal solution for those who wish to enjoy seaside living without sacrificing tranquility or convenience to essential services; Piazza Mazzini is just minutes away on foot.
